Class CreateScenarioController

java.lang.Object
controller.CreateScenarioController
public class CreateScenarioController extends Object
Controller responsible for creating and retrieving scenarios.

Delegates persistence to ScenarioRepository

  • Method Details

    • createScenario

      public Scenario createScenario(String scenarioName, String selectedMap, int[] timeRestrictions, int portBehavior, List<String> technologicalRestrictions, List<String> historicalRestrictions, double productionRate, double profitMultiplier, boolean saveToFile)
      Creates a new Scenario with the provided attributes and adds it to the repository.
      Parameters:
      scenarioName - the unique name of the scenario
      selectedMap - the name of the map associated with the scenario
      timeRestrictions - the time restrictions associated with the scenario
      portBehavior - the behavior of the ports in the scenario
      technologicalRestrictions - the technological restrictions associated with the scenario
      historicalRestrictions - the historical restrictions associated with the scenario
      productionRate - the production rate applied within the scenario
      profitMultiplier - the profit multiplier applicable in the scenario
      saveToFile - a flag indicating whether to save the scenario to a file
      Returns:
      the created Scenario instance
